target: OWASP Juice Shop (local Docker / staging testbed)
source: Public OWASP Juice Shop perimeter attack surface + observable misconfigurations without active exploit execution.

detectable_by_this_tool.label: Application reachable over HTTP without TLS
Web service listening on standard port (typically 3000 or 80)

not_detectable_passive_or_portscan.label: Score Board (hidden challenge route) — requires application business logic crawl, not perimeter discovery
DOM XSS — requires headless browser JavaScript execution and client DOM inspection
SQL injection on login — requires offensive payload injection, which AEGIS strictly forbids
Broken authentication / JWT token forging — requires application state fuzzing out of scope for perimeter RBVM
